Name: Location ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the location record. Only available when updating existing locations.

Name: Location Code
Description: A code to uniquely reference the location within the set.

Name: Set Code
Description: The code of the set to which this location belongs. This attribute is mandatory for new locations.

Name: Effective End Date
Description: If you are supplying date-effective history, the last day of the date-effective changes. If left blank, this value is the end of time by default.

Name: Effective Start Date
Description: The start date of the location or of the update to the location if you are supplying date-effective history.

Name: Action Reason Code
Description: The code for the reason why this location is created or updated.

Name: Active Status
Description: Specifies whether the location is active.

Name: Additional Address Attribute 1
Description: Additional address attribute, used by localizations.

Name: Additional Address Attribute 2
Description: Additional address attribute, used by localizations.

Name: Additional Address Attribute 3
Description: Additional address attribute, used by localizations.

Name: Additional Address Attribute 4
Description: Additional address attribute, used by localizations.

Name: Additional Address Attribute 5
Description: Additional address attribute, used by localizations.

Name: Address Line 1
Description: The first line of the location address.

Name: Address Line 2
Description: The second line of the location address.

Name: Address Line 3
Description: The third line of the location address.

Name: Address Line 4
Description: The fourth line of the location address.

Name: Annual Working Duration Units
Description: The unit of measure in hours, days, weeks, or months for the standard annual working duration.

Name: Bill-to Site
Description: Indicates the location is a bill to site.

Name: Building
Description: The building name of the address.

Name: Country
Description: The country for the location address.

Name: Deliver-to Site
Description: Indicates the location is a deliver to site.

Name: Description
Description: A description for the location in the language of the user loading your new locations. This value can be translated for other enabled languages if you supply a LocationTranslation.dat file.

Name: Designated Receiver ID
Description: A unique reference to the person designated as the receiver for this location.

Name: Designated Receiver Person Number
Description: The person number for the person designated as the receiver for this location.

Name: E-Mail
Description: The e-mail address for the location.

Name: Employee Location
Description: Indicates the location is an employee location.

Name: Fax - Area Code
Description: The area code of the fax number for this location.

Name: Fax - Country Code
Description: The country code of the fax number for this location.

Name: Fax - Extension
Description: The extension for the fax number for this location.

Name: Fax - Local Number
Description: The local number of the fax number for this location.

Name: Floor Number
Description: The floor number of the address.

Name: Geographic Hierarchy Node Code
Description: The code of the geography tree node for this location.

Name: Geographic Hierarchy Node ID
Description: The surrogate ID of the geography tree node for this location.

Name: Image URL
Description: The web address for the location image.

Name: Inventory Organization
Description: The name of the inventory organization for this location.

Name: Inventory Organization ID
Description: A unique reference to the inventory organization for this location.

Name: Latitude
Description: Distance between the equator and an address located to its north or south, expressed in degrees and minutes.

Name: Location Name
Description: The name for the location. Supply the location name in the language of the user loading your new locations. This value can be translated for other enabled languages if you supply a LocationTranslation.dat file.

Name: Long Postal Code
Description: Long postal codes are used in some countries in addition to more well-known short postal codes.

Name: Longitude
Description: Distance between the prime meridian and an address located to its east or west, expressed in degrees and minutes.

Name: Main Phone - Area Code
Description: The area code for the main phone number for this location.

Name: Main Phone - Country Code
Description: The country code for the main phone number for this location.

Name: Main Phone - Extension
Description: The extension of the main phone number for this location.

Name: Main Phone - Local Number
Description: The local number of the main phone number for this location.

Name: Office Site
Description: Indicates the location is an office site.

Name: Official Language
Description: The code of the location's official language.

Name: Other Phone - Area Code
Description: The area code of the other phone number for this location.

Name: Other Phone - Country Code
Description: The country code of the other phone number for this location.

Name: Other Phone - Extension
Description: The extension for the other phone number for this location.

Name: Other Phone - Local Number
Description: The local number of the other phone number for this location.

Name: Postal Code
Description: The postal code of the location address. This value may be mandatory depending on the country specified.

Name: Provider
Description: Company that has validated an address.

Name: Receivable Materials
Description: Lists materials that can be received at the location.

Name: Receiving Site
Description: Indicates if the location is a receiving site.

Name: Region 1
Description: The primary region in which the address is located. This value may be mandatory depending on the country specified.

Name: Region 2
Description: The subregion in which the address is located.

Name: Region 3
Description: The subregion within Region 2, in which the address is located.

Name: Set ID
Description: The surrogate ID of the set this location belongs to.

Name: Ship-to Location Code
Description: The code for the ship to location.

Name: Ship-to Location ID
Description: A unique reference to the ship to location.

Name: Ship-to Location Set Code
Description: The set code for the ship to location.

Name: Ship-to Site
Description: Indicates the location is a ship to site.

Name: Standard Annual Working Duration
Description: The standard annual working duration for the location.

Name: Standard Working Hours
Description: Number of standard working hours

Name: Standard Working Hours Frequency
Description: Frequency for the standard working hours

Name: Time-zone Name
Description: Specifies the standard time-zone name under which the address falls.

Name: Town Or City
Description: The town or city of the location address. This value may be mandatory depending on the country specified.

Name: Validation Status Code
Description: Level of accuracy of an address as determined by an address provider.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.
